# Copilot instructions for Shellfin

Shellfin is a cross-platform desktop SSH client (Tauri 2, Rust/russh, React/TypeScript). The canonical instructions
are in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) (read also `src-tauri/AGENTS.md` and `src/AGENTS.md` for the area you edit); the deep
reference is [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). Read AGENTS.md before making changes. The five rules
that matter most:

1. Every user-facing string goes through i18n (`t("key")` plus the English `src/i18n/locales/en/translation.json`; other locales are optional and fall back to English, `npm run i18n:missing` lists their gaps); no literals.
2. `src/ipc/bindings/**` is generated by ts-rs: never edit it by hand; change the Rust DTO and run `npm run bindings`.
3. The webview never passes local filesystem paths; remote/server text is shown only through `displayName`,
   `displayPath` or `displayServerText`; no `innerHTML`; keep the CSP strict and `freezePrototype` on.
4. Least-privilege ACL: every new command needs a `names.rs` entry, a capability permission and a passing ACL test.
5. Security-sensitive code needs tests, including hostile input: `ssh/`, `known_hosts/`, `sftp/save` and
   `sftp/transfer`, `platform/local_path` and `file_trust`, `window.rs` and the ACL, `storage/`. Run all gates from
   AGENTS.md before finishing; use Conventional Commits.
